commands.label: New document
commands.description: Create a bounded blank document in the workspace.

commands.label: Duplicate document
commands.description: Create an independent editable copy of the target document.
commands.agentAccessReason: Document duplication still needs a representative remote artifact and identity proof.
commands.externalMcpReason: Not admitted to Agent Access yet.

commands.label: Image size
commands.description: Resize layered document pixels and resolution through the canonical Image Size operation.

commands.label: Canvas geometry
commands.description: Apply one bounded canvas-size, crop, rotation or flip operation.

commands.label: Assign profile
commands.description: Assign the current sRGB working profile as document interpretation metadata without converting pixel values.

commands.label: Set zoom
commands.description: Set the target document viewport in explicit document coordinates.

commands.label: New raster layer
commands.description: Create one empty raster layer through normal layer history.

commands.label: Duplicate layer
commands.description: Duplicate one layer and return its new stable layer ID.

commands.label: Layer via Copy
commands.description: Copy the current selected pixels from an explicit raster source to a new layer, or copy the complete layer when no selection exists.

commands.label: Delete layers
commands.description: Delete an explicit bounded set of layers through normal undo history.

commands.label: Move layer
commands.description: Move one layer up or down within its current parent.

commands.label: Layer blend mode
commands.description: Set one layer to a supported compositing blend mode.

commands.label: Layer clipping
commands.description: Enable or disable clipping for one layer.

commands.label: Layer transform
commands.description: Set one layer's final bounded affine transform as a single committed operation.

commands.label: Rotate or flip current target
commands.description: Rotate or flip the current selection, mask, layer or selected layer group around its measured center.

commands.label: Create adjustment
commands.description: Create one visible adjustment as explicit local processing, attached processing or an adjustment layer.

commands.label: Invert raster colors
commands.description: Invert one explicit raster pixel or mask channel through a reversible GPU transaction.

commands.label: Convert text to shapes
commands.description: Replace one editable text layer in place with native vector glyph paths while retaining its stable layer ID.

commands.label: Rasterize text
commands.description: Replace one editable text layer in place with raster pixels through the reversible GPU pixel-history owner.

commands.label: Merge layers
commands.description: Composite an explicit contiguous set of sibling layers into one full-canvas raster layer.

commands.label: Flatten group
commands.description: Composite one explicit non-empty group into a raster layer at the same stack position.

commands.label: Flatten image
commands.description: Destructively composite the complete document and final global processing into one raster layer.

commands.label: Layer mask
commands.description: Add, remove or change the enabled/linked state of one explicit layer mask.

commands.label: Remove background
commands.description: Generate and apply a removable subject mask to one explicit raster layer as a cancellable task.

commands.label: Auto Align layers
commands.description: Analyze two explicit raster layers and commit the target geometry correction as a cancellable task.

commands.label: Layer lock
commands.description: Set one lock kind for an explicit bounded set of layers.

commands.label: Place artifact
commands.description: Place one bounded image artifact as a new raster layer.

commands.label: Rename layer
commands.description: Rename one existing layer by stable layer ID.

commands.label: Layer visibility
commands.description: Show or hide an explicit set of layers.

commands.label: Layer fill opacity
commands.description: Set fill opacity for one layer without changing effect opacity.

commands.label: Layer Styles visibility
commands.description: Enable or bypass the complete Layer Styles stack.

commands.label: Update Layer Styles stack
commands.description: Update bounded stack-wide Layer Styles scale or global-light settings.

commands.label: Layer effect visibility
commands.description: Enable or bypass one Layer Style effect.

commands.label: Open artifact
commands.description: Open one previously registered bounded artifact as a document.

commands.label: Create text
commands.description: Create editable point, paragraph or native path-bound text.

commands.label: Replace text
commands.description: Replace an explicit Unicode range in an editable text layer.

commands.label: Format text
commands.description: Apply validated character or paragraph formatting to a text range.

commands.label: Set text layout
commands.description: Update explicit text frame and layout properties.

commands.label: Create vector
commands.description: Create one validated editable vector element.

commands.label: Update vector
commands.description: Update one vector element through its semantic command contract.

commands.label: Remove vector
commands.description: Remove one vector element by stable ID.

commands.label: Apply Warp stroke
commands.description: Append one bounded non-destructive layer-source Warp recipe without simulating realtime pointer input.

commands.label: Fill raster target
commands.description: Apply one atomic solid fill to an explicit raster-pixel or mask target through the GPU pixel-history owner.

commands.label: Apply raster gradient
commands.description: Apply one bounded final gradient paint to explicit raster pixels or a mask without simulating its UI drag.

commands.label: Apply Face Warp operation
commands.description: Apply one semantic Face Warp operation to an existing face effect.
commands.agentAccessReason: Face Warp remains experimental and its remaining visual gates are parked.
commands.externalMcpReason: Not admitted to Agent Access while Face Warp is experimental.

commands.label: Add layer effect
commands.description: Add one validated Layer Style effect.

commands.label: Update layer effect
commands.description: Update the settings of one Layer Style effect.

commands.label: Remove layer effect
commands.description: Remove one Layer Style effect.

commands.label: Move layer effect
commands.description: Move one effect within its ordered Layer Styles stack.

commands.label: Run command batch
commands.description: Execute a validated bounded command sequence as one named publication.

commands.label: Commit tool operation
commands.description: Apply one bounded paint, selection or layer-translation operation without simulating realtime UI input.

commands.label: Apply selection shape
commands.description: Apply one final bounded geometric selection with explicit combine and rasterization settings.

commands.label: Apply Magic Wand selection
commands.description: Sample one document point on an explicit layer and apply the bounded Magic Wand recipe through the GPU selection owner.

commands.label: Select Subject
commands.description: Select the primary subject from one explicit layer or composite as a cancellable task.

commands.label: Modify selection
commands.description: Select the complete canvas, clear the current selection or invert it as one selection-only history operation.

commands.label: Set basic Grade
commands.description: Apply a validated partial patch of basic Grade controls to an explicit document or layer owner.

commands.label: Cancel task
commands.description: Cancel one running cancellable automation task.

commands.label: Export LightTable
commands.description: Create an opaque native LightTable artifact from the current document.

commands.label: Export PNG
commands.description: Create an opaque PNG artifact through the real GPU renderer.

commands.label: Export PSD
commands.description: Create an opaque PSD artifact within the supported interchange subset.

commands.label: Undo
commands.description: Undo one document history entry.

commands.label: Redo
commands.description: Redo one document history entry.
